<style>
	
	.text-center {
    text-align: center;
}

	.course-curriculums .curriculum {
  background-color: #f7f7f7;
    border: 1px solid #e2e2e2;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 20px 40px;
    box-shadow: 1px 1px 20px #0000001a;
		margin-top: 35px;
		margin-bottom: 20px;
}
	
	@media (max-width: 767px){
		.course-curriculums .curriculum {
    padding: 15px 15px;
}
	}

.course-curriculums .w-dropdown {
  padding: 10px 0;
}

.course-curriculums .w-dropdown-toggle {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 10px 0;
	flex-direction: row-reverse;
	color: #2e3261;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.course-curriculums .w-dropdown-list {
  display: none;
	background-color: #fff;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 10px 20px 10px 40px;
  line-height: 120%;
  position: relative;
}
	
	@media (max-width: 767px){
		.course-curriculums .w-dropdown-list {
  padding: 10px 15px 10px 15px;
}
	}

.course-curriculums .w-dropdown-list.active {
  display: block;
	text-align: left;
}

.course-curriculums .w-icon-dropdown-toggle {
  margin-left: auto; /* Ensure icon is on the right side */
  transition: transform 0.3s;
	height: 15px;
	width: 15px;
	position: relative;
}
	
	.course-curriculums .w-icon-dropdown-toggle::after {
    content: '';
    background-image: url(/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/down-arrow-svgrepo-com-1.png);
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    z-index: 6;
    width: 15px;
    height: 15px;
    background-size: 15px;
    background-position: center;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
}

.course-curriculums .w-dropdown-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .w-icon-dropdown-toggle {
  transform: rotate(180deg); /* Rotate icon when expanded */
}
	
	
	.course-curriculums .mocinterview-list{
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: row;
		list-style: none;
		padding: 0;
		margin: 0 auto;
		gap: 80px;
		width: fit-content;
	}
	
	@media (max-width: 767px){
		.course-curriculums .mocinterview-list{
		flex-direction: column;
			gap: 15px;
	}
	}

	.course-curriculums .item-mocinterview{
		color: #324158;
    text-align: left;
    background-image: url(/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/svgexport-1-1.png);
    background-position: 0 11px;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-size: 24px 24px;
    padding-top: 10px;
    padding-bottom: 10px;
    padding-left: 32px;
    font-weight: 400;
	}
	
	.course-curriculums .data-drop-list {
    padding-top: 14px;
    padding-bottom: 14px;
    font-weight: 400;
		font-size: 18px;
		line-height: 24px;
		color: #2e3261;
}
	
	.course-curriculums .curriculum-list li{
			margin-bottom: 15px;
		}
	
	.course-curriculums .curriculum-list{
		color: #2e3261;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 600;
	}
	
	.course-curriculums .lpv5-h3{
		font-size: 34px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 130%;
		color: #2e3261;
	}
	
	@media (max-width: 767px){
		.course-curriculums .lpv5-h3{
		font-size: 24px;
	}
	}
	
</style>




<script>

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll(".w-dropdown");

  faqItems.forEach(function(item) {
    const questionToggle = item.querySelector(".w-dropdown-toggle");
    const answer = item.querySelector(".w-dropdown-list");
    const icon = item.querySelector(".w-icon-dropdown-toggle");

    questionToggle.addEventListener("click", function() {
      const isExpanded = questionToggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";
      
      // Toggle the aria-expanded attribute
      questionToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", !isExpanded);
      
      // Toggle the visibility of the answer
      answer.classList.toggle("active", !isExpanded);

      // Optionally, rotate the icon (handled by CSS through aria-expanded attribute)
      icon.style.transform = !isExpanded ? "rotate(180deg)" : "rotate(0deg)";
    });
  });
});

</script>
